h: Dembélé and other PSG players reportedly to skip the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony despite 10 nominations
p: Several Paris Saint-Germain players are reportedly set to stay away from the Ballon d'Or ceremony even though the club has ten nominees. Ousmane Dembélé is among those named.
more: The club's fixtures are said to be behind the absences.
Kylian Mbappé's Clasico double has also stirred talk around this year's award.
